cases.prompt: Add health check endpoints to our Node API, which depends on Postgres and Redis.
expectations: Separates liveness (process is up) from readiness (dependencies reachable).
Readiness checks Postgres and Redis with short timeouts.
Returns 503 when a dependency is down and 200 when healthy, with a JSON status body.
Liveness does not depend on Postgres or Redis.

cases.prompt: Define SLOs and alerts for our checkout API.

all.why: uses error budgets or burn rate

expectations: Defines availability and latency SLIs with numeric targets.
Ties alerts to error budget or burn rate rather than single errors.
Names metrics to expose, such as a request duration histogram and error counter.
